Title: Azure Defender for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Single Server in general availability

Body.Content:
Azure Defender provides security alerts for anomalous activities so that you can detect potential threats and respond to them as they occur. When you enable this plan for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single Server, Azure Defender for open source relational databases will provide alerts when it detects anomalous database access and query patterns, as well as suspicious database activities. Security alerts will be sent by email and include:  

  • Details of the suspicious activity that triggered them
  • The associated MITRE ATTACK tactic
  • Recommended actions for how to investigate and mitigate the threat
  • Options for continuing your investigations with Azure Sentinel

Learn more about Azure Defender for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Single Server.
